# Official Seeed board source snapshot

Repository: https://github.com/Seeed-Studio/platform-seeedboards

Commit: `a6fd41debbbcda13b5340fff50c9092ed3289194`

Commit page: https://github.com/Seeed-Studio/platform-seeedboards/commit/a6fd41debbbcda13b5340fff50c9092ed3289194

Upstream commit time: 2026-10-20T01:45:17Z

Fetched (UTC): 2026-10-21T02:00:42+00:00

This read-only upstream snapshot preserves selected files verbatim. It is research/reference material, not an installed SDK or a tested build. The README describes custom NCS board roots. The LM20A V2.0 overlay and Kconfig files document the removal of the SAMD11 debugger, native USB CDC ACM console, and changed factory bootloader layout. Board revision must be checked before selecting a target.
